entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who has regained a giant dragon form through a corrupted ritual and commands wild dragons, aiming to destroy the temple and make Tarkir ruled by dragons again.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Waymaster of the Jeskai who fights Sarkhan's dragons and rediscovers her center.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: An archangel who stands against Sarkhan in a last stand to buy time and is saved by Ajani.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who rides to the fight with Felothar, leaps to save Narset and Elspeth, and decides to live in the present.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: The Abzan khan who leads her dragon riders into battle against Sarkhan's flock.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who escapes with Loot using a camouflage spell, asking what happened to Jace.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A frightened young creature, carried by Narset then Vraska, who wails after Jace's loss.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon who enters Tarkir exhausted, drives off the wild dragons, burns Sarkhan with ghostfire and reveals that Bolas is free.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon freed from his prison in the Meditation Realm, laughing as the realm dissolves.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The mind mage who shattered in the dissolving Meditation Realm.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: The monk Narset suspects gave Sarkhan the Stormnexus Ritual.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: The Jeskai dragonlord whose quiet company Narset recalls.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian praetor under whom Ajani was collared.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: The angel whom Elspeth hopes would look kindly on her in the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Karrthus
entities.description: A dragon from which Sarkhan once saved Ajani.

entities.name: Shiko
entities.description: The Jeskai spirit dragon Narset wishes could be by her side.

entities.name: Wild dragons
entities.description: Dragons born from the dragonstorms who are bound to Sarkhan by the corrupted ritual.

entities.name: Abzan dragons
aliases: the dragons of the Abzan clan
entities.description: The Abzan clan's dragons and riders who join the battle and suffer heavy casualties.

entities.name: Temple in the heart of the storms
entities.description: The ancient temple housing the Omenpath, which Sarkhan's dragons tear apart.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The realm that burned away into nothing.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: The portal from the Meditation Realm into the temple.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: The ritual Narset suspects Sarkhan used, corrupted by a terrible sacrifice, binding the wild dragons to him.

entities.name: Dragonstorms
entities.description: Storms that keep producing more monstrous dragons.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane under attack by Sarkhan's flock.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: The clan whose dragons aid the fight.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The clan led by Narset.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group Narset wonders whether still exists.

events.summary: Sarkhan, bound to the dragons by the ritual, resolves to destroy the temple that rivals his control.
participants: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: And the first thing he needed to do was destroy the temple.

events.summary: Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone and he and Ugin vanish into the nothing as the Meditation Realm burns away.
events.quote: Bolas and Ugin winking out of existence, eaten by the nothing, dead now, perhaps.

events.summary: Elspeth carries Narset and Loot through the Omenpath into the temple, where Vraska takes Loot.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: they were on the other side: outside the temple, Elspeth in the air, Vraska somehow beside her, arms held out for Loot.

events.summary: Narset climbs out and sees the sky black with dragons, and Elspeth names Sarkhan.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms

events.summary: Vraska escapes with Loot under a camouflage spell as Narset and Elspeth decide to stand against Sarkhan.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms

events.summary: Elspeth challenges Sarkhan in the air and says she is not afraid of him.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: I am not afraid of you.

events.summary: Narset fights the dragon flock, redirecting their momentum, and recovers her inner center.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: Narset found what she had lost: her center

events.summary: Ajani, riding with Felothar, sees Narset in danger and decides to leap from his dragon.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: he really could just choose to do something.

events.summary: Ajani lands and beheads a creature about to bite Narset, and the Abzan dragons descend upon Sarkhan's flock.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: the dragons of the Abzan clan rose from the storm and descended upon Sarkhan's flock.

events.summary: Elspeth plunges toward Sarkhan's open mouth as her last stand.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: Elspeth pulled her wings close to her back, plummeting through the sky like a stone

events.summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

events.summary: Sarkhan, stung with shame, vows to bathe the Multiverse in fire and goes after Elspeth.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: I want to bathe the Multiverse in fire for what it has done to me.

events.summary: Ajani catches the falling Elspeth and says he came to fight with her in the present.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: To fight with you in the present.

events.summary: Abzan dragons suffer mounting casualties, and Narset, Ajani and Elspeth plan to blind Sarkhan.
events.location: Temple in the heart of the storms
events.quote: If each of us goes for one of his eyes, we might be able to blind him

events.summary: Ugin arrives and the wild dragons flee.
events.quote: The wild dragons simply fled, shrieking their terror

events.summary: Ugin burns Sarkhan with ghostfire and Sarkhan dives away through the storm.
events.quote: Sarkhan screamed as it enveloped him.

events.summary: Ugin admits he has failed to keep his brother and that Bolas is free.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas, I am afraid, is free.

relations.note: commands the dragons through the ritual

relations.quote: To fight with you in the present.
Narset looked upon her friends—yes, she could call them that now
She was once again in her soldier's regalia, holding the dragon's reins with practiced ease.
And I have been remiss in the keeping of my brother.
The ghostfire pouring out had neither color nor heat, but Sarkhan screamed as it enveloped him.

relations.note: fights her and tries to swallow her
relations.quote: I told you the last time we fought that you would die if you came after us again.
a camouflage spell twining around her and the child.

relations.note: once saved Ajani from the dragon Karrthus and counseled him
relations.quote: Sarkhan had saved him from the dragon Karrthus
